name: Private workspace CRUD and account separation
covers: manus sparas och kvarstår efter uppdatering
description: Owner A can create, edit and delete a script, then sign out; another session does not see owner A's draft or preview.
steps: Sign in as Actor A. Create and save a manual QA script, reload and verify it persists.
Edit the script and reload to confirm the new content is durable.
Open Videostudio, select the saved script, then log out.
Sign in as Actor B on the same device. Verify actor A's script and editor text are absent, and the dashboard shows only actor B's data.
Sign out Actor B; sign in Actor A, delete the QA script and reload to confirm it is gone.
expected: Scripts persist only for their owners, and no editor or preview data leaks across logins.

name: Database self-check, theme choice and compact navigation
covers: database creation, read, conditional update and deletion
light and dark mode after reload
description: A logged-in user can run a backend diagnostic without writing to personal project data.
steps: Sign in and open Systemkontroll.
Click Kör grundsystemtest and inspect detailed results.
Verify the diagnostic reports the actual server and database checks, and all passed when the database is operational.
Verify the queue API status appears and the page states that automatic scheduled work is paused.
Reload the page and confirm saved projects remain intact.
Go to System > Inställningar. Choose Ljust and confirm the page, sidebar, cards, forms and labels use a readable light palette.
Reload and sign out/in: Ljust must persist on the same account. A new account defaults to Mörkt. Switch back to Mörkt and verify dark appearance is unchanged.
Expand Upptäck, Skapa, Resultat and System from the simplified navigation; verify every original page is still accessible.
Open Översikt, expand Fler detaljer and Chefens statusunderlag and confirm their original actions remain available.
expected: Backend diagnostic returns evidenced checks without modifying saved projects. Any failing check is displayed explicitly. User-selected light/dark appearance persists per account; grouped navigation and collapsible overview retain all original functionality.

name: Controllable authenticated HTTP 503 and safe recovery
description: Simulate an actual HTTP 503 from a protected test route, exercise the same workspace loader and retry view used for a real failure.
steps: Sign in on an account with a saved test project. Go to Systemkontroll.
Click Simulera serverfel (503). Confirm the protected endpoint intentionally responds HTTP 503.
Confirm the normal workspace disappears, an error appears, and the screen shows Försök igen. It must never pretend that user projects were deleted.
Click Försök igen. Confirm the same account's saved projects and controls return, without changing their content.
Confirm no AI generation, automatic publishing or background job was started.
expected: The app fails visibly and closed on a genuine HTTP 503 response, then successfully reloads the original private workspace on retry.

name: Queue access, cancellation and safe guardrails
description: A user can inspect queue state and cannot accidentally trigger charged generation or publishing.
steps: Sign in and open Bakgrundsjobb; confirm visible quality-assurance pause disclosure.
Create one unpaid source-only task for a future time, confirm it persists on refresh.
Cancel the future job and reload; verify it remains cancelled.
Select AI pipeline with the explicit-cost checkbox unchecked, and verify it cannot be added.
Confirm the app has no automatic publishing or background render controls.
expected: Queue entries persist, cancellation works, and no charged calls or publishing happen without explicit approval.

name: Trend research manager and owner-approved script handoff
description: A private trend candidate can be saved, edited, removed, and used to start an original manual script.
covers: MP4 text scene balancing without orphaned final words
no AI or publishing without consent
AI quality suggestion requires separate consent
original script remains unchanged after AI quality analysis
AI review receipt per manuscript revision
free source-agnostic per-revision collaborative editorial workflow
steps: Sign in and open Trendlabb, find one existing YouTube source or fetch it manually.
Click Spara kandidat, refresh, and verify it remains under Sparade.
Change status to Undersöks, add a note, save and refresh; verify note and status persist.
Click Skriv eget manus and verify a new manual draft opens with its source URL and without copying video content.
Remove the candidate, refresh and verify it is gone.
Verify Publicering remains blocked.

Open an original, saved 19-word manual English script, use Skapa MP4 and download the result. Confirm the final word is not a separate 5-second scene, and that the file decodes as 1080x1920, 24 FPS, H.264 with no sound.
After the update, navigate through Översikt, Trendlabb, Videostudio and Bakgrundsjobb and verify content is retained while scheduled jobs remain paused.
Sign in, collect YouTube signals manually if necessary, open Skapa > AI-agenter and click Skapa researchplan.
Verify a stored plan contains three or fewer source-linked candidates, evidence/limits and specialist stage notes. Refresh and confirm plan persists.
Click Välj denna idé and verify the selected item stays selected after refresh. Choose Skriv originalmanus; confirm Videostudio pre-fills title and source, not copied content.
Verify manager planning and selection did not initiate AI generation, MP4 export, background jobs or publishing. AI-manus must still require separate explicit consent.

Re-fetch enough new sources to evict an older shortlisted video; the saved plan must still allow manual manuscript creation from its snapshotted source/title. Paid AI draft remains unavailable without a current trend record.
Open a saved English manuscript in Videostudio and expand Manusanalys och AI-kvalitetskontroll; verify free word/hook/paragraph/source checks display without credit consent.

With AI-provning disabled, verify paid AI-granska is disabled. With AI-provning enabled explicitly, confirm that review requires a separate unknown-cost confirmation and runs at most once per project revision.

When an AI quality report exists, reload and verify it persists; use Använd förslaget i redigeraren and verify the existing server-saved script is not replaced until Spara manus is explicitly clicked.
Verify the report is owner scoped, does not claim factual verification, never approves or publishes a video, and uses the existing shared provider-credit quota.
In Videostudio open a saved English script, expand Agentflöde · Samordnad manusgranskning and start the free four-stage workflow; the server saves role-by-role observations without calling AI.
Refresh and verify the same editorial run persists. Confirm AI-agenter shows its status and opens that same saved manuscript.
Confirm rights/fact acknowledgments require two user checkboxes, do not imply independent verification and do not auto-approve a manuscript or upload.
Attest manually, reload and verify status is Underlag redo för manuell manusgranskning. Change and save script; old run cannot be reused and a new review is required for the new revision.
Verify account B cannot see account A's editorial reports. No background AI job, credits, video export, or publishing are triggered by either endpoint.
expected: Candidate saves, updates, deletions and source-link handoff are durable and private without automatic production. MP4 split is balanced with no orphaned last word. Manager plans and selections persist privately, with no automatic AI spend or uploads. The owner-scoped four-stage free editorial report persists by project revision. Manual source/rights attestation is not final script or publication approval.
